page_title: Item:Legendary Claws of the Coldlight Walker

enchantments.tooltip: Improved Deception: This item makes your weapons hard to focus upon and thus provides a +22 enhancement bonus to Bluff checks. In addition, while using this item your weapons have a chance to envelop the target in darkness, making them vulnerable to sneak attacks for a short time.
Quality Assassinate +4: +4 Quality bonus to the DC of character's Assassinate attempts.
Lamordia: Melancholic Slot (Accessory):Apply a Lamordia augment to this item.
Lamordia: Dolorous Slot (Accessory):Apply a Lamordia augment to this item.
Mythic Hands Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
